title: Import source snapshots and define headless fork entries
contractChanges: packages/core/src/contracts.ts is now the owned internal contract (seeded from the design package's proposal).
packages/core/src/runtime/protocol.ts defines the parent<->worker wire, protocol version 1, 8 MiB message ceiling.

commands.cmd: per-file git blob sha comparison against the pinned trees
npm ci && npm run build in vendor/zvec-grep and vendor/codegraph (Node v22.22.3)
sha256 of built dist vs published dist

tests.name: test/contracts/headless-entries.test.js
tests.detail: forbidden-subtree reachability, no started resources on import, exported surface, ledger parity

findings: Both published Node distributions are byte-reproducible from the pinned commits. This closes the tag-source vs package-parity gate that U00 left open.

One local patch was required to satisfy the headless exit condition: upstream vendor/codegraph/src/index.ts:96 re-exported MCPServer from './mcp', which made src/upgrade/update-check (a background GitHub update probe reached from src/mcp/index.ts:53) and src/telemetry reachable from the library entry. Removed; the only in-tree consumer, src/bin/codegraph.ts:1867, uses a dynamic import and is unaffected.
Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. Hoisting would resolve zvec-grep and CodeGraph onto one dependency set and invalidate their pinned locks. One command, one ordering, three independent node_modules.
knownLimitations: vendor/codegraph/dist/lazy-entry.js still reaches mcp/version.js, a leaf that only reads package.json for the version string. The test pins that exact module and forbids every other MCP module.
vendor/serena is imported and verified but not yet built or exercised; that is U05.
rollback: Remove vendor/, packages/core/, scripts/build-unified.mjs, scripts/verify-vendor.mjs and revert the four modified root files. The existing CLI/MCP query path is untouched by this unit and keeps working.
